s3.subtitle: Garage S3 server for your apps’ s3 disks.

public.title: Make {bucket} public?
public.description: Every object in {bucket} can be read and downloaded without credentials by anyone who can reach this machine, including objects stored as private.
public.hint: To make only some objects public, keep the bucket private and use the public-read ACL (Laravel’s “public” visibility).

delete.hint: Its hosts and DNS records are removed.
